clean.tx: … elokim hevi laxem siman ʃelo taalu al hamitkan beʃabat vehine hu hetkia etxem le40 dakot bejom ʃabat kodeʃ
clean.tl: … G-d gave you a sign not to go on the ride on Saturday, and there you go, he made you get stuck for 40 minutes on the holy Sabbath.

clean.tx: betviatam toanim haʃnaim ki gilboa hexʃid et deri beretsixata ʃel ester verderber
clean.tl: The two claim in their lawsuit that Gilboa turned Deri into a suspect in the murder of Esther Verderber.

clean.tx: Hana lōnbloe saka sabab mantöng le di rumoh.
clean.tl: I am not buying any sugar because there is still much at home.

clean.tx: Ngurna karrapparnirni nyaya kurtirni ngurna pirrkapma manku.
clean.tl: I have only looked at it ; I’ll do the repairs later.
